title: Exports that do not take the database down
summary: Let people download very large reports without hurting everyone else using the product.
context: Cubbon Traders' users export reports of up to 2 million rows. The export runs inside the web request, against the main database. At month end, a few exports slow everything for everybody, and many time out after several minutes with nothing to show.
A report may contain sensitive prices and should not be readable by anyone with the link. Most people want the same few reports at month end.
must_handle: A person can start an export and leave the page.
Exports do not noticeably slow the main product.
A long export survives a worker restart.
Only the right people can download the file, and it expires.
One company's many exports do not block everyone else's.
show_in_answer: What happens from pressing Export to holding the file.
Where the report reads from, and how that protects the main database.
How the file is stored and shared.
How the work is shared fairly between companies.
